scope: Final 1.6.33 Android acceptance after the live episode count, cold resume and fresh Latin-search fixes. These checks are separate from the original 19-route sweep and its APK hash.

checks.name: Cold Continue Watching
checks.note: Canonical title may merge to FMovies while the exact StarDima episode stays selected.

checks.name: Fresh Latin search
checks.note: Visible source search result appears before opening its title; no invented Latin alias is required.

checks.name: Latin search
checks.result: Arabic StarDima titles visible alongside other providers; selected actual StarDima row.

checks.name: Inline playback
checks.evidence: Two screenshots show different frames of the source cartoon, with Playing and StarDima - Lulustream selected within the title page.
checks.note: The source choice changed during opening; final selected choice was Lulu. No signed-build HG or Media3 success is claimed.

checks.name: Exit playback
checks.result: Normal app Back returns to title; no trapped black player surface.

checks.name: Cold restart persistence
checks.result: After force-stop and relaunch, Continue Watching shows Kaiju No. 8, S4 · E01, 42% watched. Previous film progress also remains.

limitations: The original sweep tested 19 public choices for four selected titles, not every catalogue item. Nine unique routes had an advancing clock in at least one attempt.
Mixdrop samples were unavailable; Savefiles and legacy HG samples did not produce advancing playback within their bounded tests.
Lulu native-HLS attempts failed with HTTP-status errors in the earlier audit; its inline WebView fallback played.
A previous signed-draft Uqload check displayed source promotion overlays. Ad-free playback is not guaranteed.
The source labels the short Kaiju sample as S4E1 and reports a 224.057-second duration in the instrumented draft test. No full-episode or language verification claim is made.
One emulator process exited during the earlier draft tests. The same AVD was restarted without wiping data; final checks completed afterward.

cleanup.note: Temporary display overrides were reset and the same AVD was stopped normally. No wipe or deletion was performed.
